坐标使用游戏原生单位；角度按俯仰 / 水平 / 翻滚排列。缺失数据显示 —。: Coordinates use native game units; angles are pitch / yaw / roll in degrees. Missing values appear as —.
Reader 原始视点由人物原点与原始偏移相加；已求值的原生视点尚未下发。: Reader's raw eye position is the pawn origin plus raw view offset. The evaluated native eye position is not supplied yet.

点击“开始采集”后，在此区域自然移动鼠标: Select Start capture, then move your mouse naturally in this area
发现不同的旧配置。请选择要迁移的来源，原始文件将保留。: Different legacy settings were found. Choose a source to import; the original files will be preserved.
五档为当前链路每轴上限的18.75%/25%/50%/75%/100%。最高速度: The five presets use 18.75%/25%/50%/75%/100% of the current per-axis link limit. Maximum speed = min(axis count limit, floor(XY budget / 2)) × 1000 / effective interval. The interval respects both firmware capabilities and the 8N1 serialization time of each 48-byte START+MOTION pair. Acceleration and jerk scale proportionally; learned samples are not amplified. Automatic 115200/500000 baud detection requires valid, progressing feedback. Capability changes stop output and require a fresh button release. Physical mouse passthrough stays independent at 1ms. Stale feedback blocks output; holding the button has no duration limit.
当前链路 {{baud}} baud · 单轴 {{step}} 计数 / {{: Current link: {{baud}} baud · {{step}} counts per axis / {{interval}} ms. Presets scale to the link limit.
尚未识别盒子，显示 v5 参考上限；连接后按实际链路能力自动换算。: Showing v5 reference limits until the box is identified. Presets adapt to the connected device.
0 表示不限；启用限制时，隐藏无法确认距离的人物。: 0 means unlimited. When limited, characters with unknown distance are hidden.

has_current_item为true只证明当前持有物品，不代表枪械或可开火: has_current_item true confirms a selected item, not a firearm or permission to fire. False means verified empty hands; missing means unknown. Live matching uses the current weapon's actual class_name. The catalog reserves item-ID matching, which the current Reader projection does not populate. Conflicting aliases with different parameters are rejected; display names are never guessed. Parameters come from one published base-data version, without attachment, special-ammunition or firing-mode adjustments. reference_only provenance is retained. A validated replacement pack is swapped atomically; an unchanged revision does not reset control.
仅在合格目标中选择：按人物三维距离，或按所选部位与准星的角差排序；按住侧键后保持: Rank eligible targets by 3D distance or the selected body part’s angular distance from the crosshair. Keep the same target while the side button is held.
优先级自动保存，下次启动继续使用；修改后松开侧键再按。: Priority is saved automatically and restored next time. Release and press the side button again after changing it.
排除自己、队友、缺队伍、缺部位和无效几何，通过角度与距离限制后排序。人物距离优先: Exclude self, teammates, missing team or aim point, and invalid geometry. Enforce cone and range before ranking. Distance priority compares 3D distance then crosshair angle; crosshair priority compares angle then 3D distance. Character ID breaks remaining ties. Ranking applies before locking and never steals a held target. Health, weapons and visibility do not add rankings.
已连接，等待完整当前数据: Connected; waiting for complete current data
串口已打开，盒子回传缺失或未就绪: Serial port is open; mousebox feedback is missing or not ready
盒子已连接，固件能力不足以运行当前速度档位: Mousebox is connected; firmware cannot support the selected speed
盒子已连接，回传正常: Mousebox is connected; feedback is current
数据、目标选择、弹道与原生方向的计算来源。: Sources for data, target selection, ballistics and native direction.
输入换算、五档速度、移动曲线与快速纠偏原理。: Input conversion, five speed presets, motion curves and tracking correction.
角度误差换算为鼠标计数，主动接近使用短 S 曲线，锁定后使用快速纠偏。: Angular error becomes mouse counts. Acquisition uses a short S-curve; tracking uses fast correction.
数值来自当前原生控制算法。它是每轴鼠标计数上限，不是像素/秒或固定转向角速度；实: Values come from the native controller. Limits apply to raw counts per axis, not pixels or a fixed angular speed. Sensitivity, FOV, acceleration, braking and model limits also affect motion.
显示每轴鼠标计数速度上限，不是像素/秒；实际转向速度随灵敏度与 FOV 变化。: Shows the mouse count speed limit per axis, not pixels/s. Angular speed varies with sensitivity and FOV.
相机参考使用手动等效归零；原生参考使用 Reader 中已含归零的方向，不再扣此: The camera reference applies manual equivalent zeroing. Native control uses the Reader direction with zeroing already applied.
当前使用原生方向，原生归零距离: Native direction is active. Native zeroing distance
DPI 用于学习速度缩放和实测校准标识；原始鼠标计数不在 FOV 换算中再次乘以: DPI scales learned speed and identifies calibration profiles. Raw counts are not multiplied by DPI again during FOV conversion.
FOV 自动更新；灵敏度模式仍由你选择。普通视角使用常规灵敏度，瞄准使用 aim: FOV updates automatically; select the sensitivity mode manually. Normal view uses general sensitivity, aiming uses aim, and scopes use ADS.
换算方式与实测记录移至“校准与诊断”的高级区域。: Mapping options and measured profiles are in the advanced section of Calibration & diagnostics.
当前使用实时 FOV 公式，已保存的实测记录不参与跟随输出。: The live FOV formula is active. Saved measured profiles are not used for tracking output.
当前仅使用与 FOV、灵敏度模式匹配的实测记录；缺失或匹配歧义时不输出。: Uses measured profiles matching FOV and sensitivity mode only. Missing or ambiguous matches stop output.
端口每5秒检测，连接失败后每5秒重试；启动时立即尝试。: Ports are scanned every 5 seconds. Failed connections retry after 5 seconds. Startup connects immediately.
轻微动作变化仅在启用速度模型后参与主动接近；接近目标及快速纠偏时不叠加。: Motion variation requires an active speed model and only affects acquisition. It fades near the target and is excluded from tracking correction.
学习模型仅限制主动接近的速度、加速和制动；锁定后的快速纠偏不使用学习上限。: The model limits acquisition speed, acceleration and braking. Tracking correction does not use learned limits.
所有Reader TCP通道近1秒收发流量，含消息头和心跳；不含TCP/IP头及: Traffic across all Reader TCP streams over the last second, including record framing and heartbeats; excludes TCP/IP headers and retransmissions. 1 kb/s = 1000 bit/s = 125 bytes/s.
近1秒平均：Reader开始读取这批数据 → GPU绘制完成通知；含线程唤醒延时: Last-second average: Reader batch read start to GPU completion notification. Includes worker wakeup delay, excludes monitor scanout. Cross-machine timing uses the existing clock-offset estimate.
等待此通道当前数据: Waiting for current data on this stream
近1秒没有完成绘制的新批次: No newly drawn batches in the last second
{{count}}批 · 时钟估算误差最多±{{error}} ms: {{count}} batches · estimated clock uncertainty up to ±{{error}} ms
接收帧率：近1秒此TCP通道收到的有效新业务批次，排除心跳、时钟探测和重复基线。: Receive rate: new valid business batches on this TCP stream in the last second, excluding heartbeats, clock probes and baseline retransmissions.
近1秒实际完成GPU绘制的帧数；独立于接收帧率，无固定绘制限帧。: Frames with completed GPU drawing in the last second. Independent of the receive rate; rendering has no fixed FPS cap.
用于Living与Local整帧的采样区间配对。: Used to pair the sampling intervals of complete Living and Local frames.
Local相机与Living己方身体速度的采样差上限；0–5000 ms，默认1: Maximum sampling skew between the Local camera and your body's Living velocity; 0–5000 ms, default 100 ms. Saved automatically. Release and press the side button after changing it.
整帧Living/Local允许差 %1 ms；补偿采样差 %2 ms；源进展期: Living/Local frame skew limit: %1 ms; compensation skew limit: %2 ms; source-progress timeout: 800 ms.
P当前 = P采样 + V × 数据年龄。源区间中点映射到本机时钟；年龄+误差≤: Current P = sampled P + V × data age. The source-interval midpoint is mapped to the local clock; age plus uncertainty ≤250 ms, uncertainty ≤25 ms, same-Living target bone/velocity skew ≤100 ms, Local-camera/Living-self-velocity skew ≤%1 ms (user setting), probe age ≤3000 ms. Failure never reuses stale velocity. Bullet flight time is separate.
按枪械类别选择瞄准部位: Aim body part by weapon category
根据当前手持武器自动切换：手枪默认头部，步枪和冲锋枪默认颈部，狙击枪默认胸部。狙: Switch automatically with your current weapon: handguns default to head, rifles and SMGs to neck, and sniper rifles to chest. Snipers include bolt-action and semi-automatic rifles. Other or unrecognized weapons use the general aim part; each category can also inherit it.
切枪时保留同一锁定目标，并按新部位的 Hitbox 取点。命中体姿态缺失时暂停跟: Switching weapons keeps the same target and samples the new body part's hitbox. Tracking pauses when the pose is missing. Release and hold the side button again after editing settings.
根据当前持枪自动选择，按游戏保存；未知枪械使用默认部位。修改后松开侧键再按。: Switch automatically with the current weapon and save per workspace. Unknown weapons use the default. Release and press the side button after changing settings.
SR 按资料中的狙击步枪类别划分，也包含 Lynx AMR 和 Win94，并非: SR follows the source sniper-rifle family, including Lynx AMR and Win94; it does not mean every weapon is bolt-action.
从角色视点到资源头部命中体的首次接触点，计入距离、穿透、爆头倍率、当前护甲和头盔: Uses the first head hitbox contact from the player eye, with distance, penetration, head multiplier, current armor and helmet. Incomplete pose or target data displays —.
≈ 表示默认服务器规则且目标非无敌条件下的估算，并非实际命中记录。扣血范围保留未: ≈ assumes default server rules and a vulnerable target; it is not a recorded hit. HP loss bounds preserve unknown fractional damage. Spread, other players blocking the shot and server lag compensation are not predicted.
等待头部伤害运行库: Waiting for the head damage library
部分头部命中路径或护甲数据不完整，伤害显示为未知: Some head impact paths or armor data are incomplete; damage is unknown
默认规则且目标非无敌条件下的预计头部伤害: Estimated head damage assuming default rules and a vulnerable target
向左拖动可收起，向右拖动展开，双击恢复默认: Drag left to collapse, drag right to expand; double-click to reset
正态分布集中在中点，标准差为区间宽度的六分之一；均匀分布让每个整数等概率；三角分: Normal clusters around the midpoint with a standard deviation of one sixth of the width. Uniform gives each integer equal probability. Triangular probability decreases linearly from the midpoint. The lower and higher modes favor their respective ends.
所有模式均限制在上下限内，并取整为整数。上下限相同时使用固定值。: All modes stay within the bounds and produce integers. Equal bounds give a fixed value.
